caption: A cloner that copies |0⟩ and |1⟩ is forced by linearity to send |+⟩ to (|00⟩+|11⟩)/√2, while a true clone would be |+⟩|+⟩ with four terms. The inner product of these two states is 0.7071, not 1, so no universal cloner exists.

spec.title: Why |+⟩ cannot be cloned
spec.aria: A downward flowchart: a supposed cloner that copies 0 and 1 is applied to the superposition plus with amplitudes 0.7071 each, giving the entangled state (00+11)/root-2, while the true clone plus-plus has four terms of 0.5; their inner product is 0.7071, not 1, so no cloner exists.
